query: How do veteran rank and service length (flag-officer vs lower rank; years served) differentially predict audit-quality outcomes and earnings-management measures?

response.query: How do veteran rank and service length (flag-officer vs lower rank; years served) differentially predict audit-quality outcomes and earnings-management measures?
response.answer: Veteran rank and longer service correlate with lower earnings-management and higher audit quality, with flag-officers generally showing stricter oversight.
